tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen: warm snow by day, pine night in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, list groups and sheets that sit on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Icon tiles, avatar wells, the reveal stage and inset panels.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and the 1px edge of cards and inputs.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders on hover and outline buttons. Holds 3:1 on `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the mascot outline. Reads on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `red-100` and `green-100`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, helper text, timestamps. Reads on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: red-100
tokens.usage: Soft red fills: tinted hero cards, red badges, gift icon tiles.

tokens.name: red-300
tokens.usage: Decorative red: cover blocks, confetti.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Christmas red, the brand color. Fill of primary buttons and Flocke's Santa hat; always with `on-red` text.

tokens.name: red-600
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `red-500` fills.

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Red text and links on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `red-100`.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `red-500` and `red-600`.

tokens.name: green-100
tokens.usage: Soft pine fills: success notices, green badges, alternate icon tiles.

tokens.name: green-300
tokens.usage: Decorative green: cover blocks.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Pine green. Fill of secondary buttons, Flocke's scarf and gift boxes; always with `on-green` text.

tokens.name: green-600
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `green-500` fills.

tokens.name: green-700
tokens.usage: Green text and links on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `green-100`.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `green-500` and `green-600`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Christmas gold: stars, the countdown dot, the active reel ring. Never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and the delete action, always with an icon or the word. Reads on `surface-raised` and `danger-100`.

tokens.name: danger-100
tokens.usage: Background of error notices.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with a 2px offset; 3:1 or more on every surface.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per screen: the reveal result and the login welcome.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: List row titles, wish item names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Trag ein, was du dir wünschst.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows' icon tile and text; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of large cards and sheets.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections; space around the mascot.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of hero screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small icon tiles, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, wish rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets, the phone-sized app frame, the reveal stage.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and pills.

tokens.usage: Cards and list groups on `surface`.
